description.value: Rockies Pizzeria & Grill is a full-service family restaurant in Radium Hot Springs serving handcrafted pizzas, BBQ ribs, steaks, burgers, and pastas with hearty portions. It holds a 5-star TripAdvisor rating and is a noted local favourite in the Columbia Valley. Takeout, delivery, and online ordering are all available, making it a flexible refuelling option for touring cyclists passing through.
